PDF An Approximate Mie Scattering Function for Fog and Cloud Rendering - NVIDIA
ABSTRACT The Mie phase function describes the complex shapes that arise when light is scattered by water droplets. Inconvenient tables of data are required to include Mie scattering in a path tracer. To avoid this complexity, analytic models such as Cornette-Shanks (CS) or Henyey-Greenstein (HG) mixtures are often used instead, resulting in a lack of accuracy for fog, clouds, skies and tissue ...
